==Description==
''A loyal Autobot warrior, noble guardian, and protector of the innocent. The ancients carved his likeness to keep watch over their city and protect them from harm. Awarded for conquering the "A Question of Loyalty" Special Mission.''

==Boost==
*Tier 1: +1% Attack and Health in Special Missions
*Tier 2: +2%
*Tier 3: +4%
